The default changed in PR #3412 (commit `6e8da1b`, ticket O3-5652). The status default in `statusConceptUuid` moved from the Medication dispense status concept (`167157AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA`, source type "Concept set") to the newly published procedure-status concept (`f0d47b45-8303-4cdc-a9f2-c37135a3700f`, source type "Answer to"). The diff removed the TODO that flagged the borrowed concept.

The README still documents the old default (`167157AAAA…`, "Concept set"), so it is out of date.

Evidence, best first:
1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-procedures-app/src/config-schema.ts` lines 43–54: the current default, showing the new UUID and "Answer to" source type.
2. The diff of commit `6e8da1b1b5a459933ca78eaabf87713592f5ab61` on that same file: the old and new defaults and the removed TODO.
3. PR #3412 (merged 2026-06-23, linked to O3-5652): its body says it updates the default to the newly added Procedure Status Concept, and it names the ticket.
4. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-procedures-app/README.md` lines 51–52: the stale documentation of the old default.
5. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-procedures-app/src/workspaces/procedures-form/procedures.form.component.tsx` lines 53–54 and 132–133: where the status UUID and source type are read and used to query the status choices.
6. Commit `6797e139e35959962c51b4148213d88ccdc94af7` (O3-5077, PR #3320): the original feature that introduced the form and the borrowed default.
